title: fart
summary: To let gas out of your bottom. A very old word for a very silly sound.
question: Where did this word come from?
completion: fart ← Old English feortan. You followed the action word back within England. Old Norse freta is a related word on another branch. Pip would like everyone to know that the suspicious noise was definitely a dragon.
partner: Pip suspects a dragon. Or the detective.
